test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 8 girls P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order). P is to the immediate right of T. P is fifth to the right of U. S is fifth to the left of T. W is third to the right of S. Only two girls sit between Q and V. V is an immediate neighbour of P. Which pair of girls is at the extreme ends of the row?
solution:
**Given: **8 girls P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order).

1. P is fifth to the right of U.

2. P is to the immediate right of T.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2920e64f056c992bd61fbd2787253905e09191a7c91a18a2bf11d29eea3daeb.png] 

3. S is fifth to the left of T.

The above statement is violated in Case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65e2a0a91d35bb83eb829cf6517b3f3f7f2d65e626b0f37975815833ed1153d7.png] 

4. V is an immediate neighbour of P.

The above statement is violated in Case III, so it is eliminated.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb325c312241cf06e95a73cd991819d63b57917bc71511c9625313852ad84dd7.png] 

5. W is third to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c04a7638d3f49a4905ec3458af69c5adee3cf8ebe7b7a1be05fd5cc4d9c039ad.png] 

6. Only two girls sit between Q and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dbb6e657092cc6dcb48e6ec69cf4bb9a41196f18df9d6e198271ee8f2637e8b.png] 

R, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc6a14cea07c80d52b9f430528bc6928221a2e18e601142e99a5914d8fc6078b.png] 

Thus, V and S are the pair of girls who sits at the extreme ends of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
